title: The Disappearance of Louis Le Prince
hook: Who stole the first filmmaker before his debut?
headline: The filmmaker who vanished overnight

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In September 1890, Louis Le Prince boarded a train from Dijon for his film.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: He was last seen at Dijon station, never reaching Paris, according to witnesses from Creusot.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: His luggage arrived in Paris, but his body was never recovered despite police searches.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Investigators later found a mysterious note alleging a family dispute over patents, still unsolved.

end.line: What really happened to the film pioneer?

description: Explore the baffling disappearance of cinema's earliest inventor, Louis Le Prince.

facts.claim: Louis Le Prince boarded a train from Dijon on 16 September 1890.
He was last seen at Le Creusot station and never arrived in Paris.
His luggage arrived in Paris, but his body was never recovered.
A handwritten note was found suggesting a family dispute over patent rights.
